initial_application: Commit 0667dac4d8 added product definition targetProfiles to ActivityDefinition.subjectReference and limited subjectCanonical to EvidenceVariable, but left prose and SVG tooltip text saying product definitions were canonical-reference targets.
additional_context: The later FHIR-37485 PlanDefinition decision clarified that non-canonical product definition resources belong under subjectReference. ActivityDefinition is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, and community searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml, definition-mapping exceptions, and checked-in SVG tooltip to describe product definitions as Reference targets and canonical subject references as limited to EvidenceVariable.
